ServiceWork counted credit-window refusals but not other pre-credit submission failures such as stale capability, authority/format or unavailable registry slot.

Fixed per-class submission attempts/refusals count every try_submit path before invocation. Existing credit-window refusal and dispatched counters keep their original separate scopes.
verification: Public admission refusal leaves artifact absent; creation success/real SQLite-full both report receipt. Service tests distinguish retained-credit refusal, pre-admission Denied/stale rejection, and queued Denied dispatch without provider replay. No panic injection, worker retry or provider policy change.
